[SWS_CM_00087] Precondition for Proxy destruction
⌈
To avoid dangling refer-
ences to Event sample data (referred to by a SamplePtr) which has not yet been handed back to communication management by the application, it is required that all
SamplePtrs provided by GetNewSamples() are released (by calling any of the APIs
defined in [SWS_CM_11547], [SWS_CM_11539], [SWS_CM_11540], or [SWS_CM_-
11545]) before destroying the Proxy (e.g., by letting it go out of scope). If this precon-
dition is not met, a violation shall be raised as per [SWS_CORE_00003].
⌋
